comparison.objective: Set and lock a mechanical opening stop versus perform a two-hand musical passage with specified notes, timing, and dynamics.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires sustained tool seating and rotational counterforce; keyboard playing requires coordinated key timing, simultaneous notes, differential strike velocities, and releases.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained angle and hardware state after cycling; keyboard success checks note order, onset synchronization, velocity separation, tempo regularity, and final key/hand clearance.
comparison.reason: No meaningful objective, mechanism, or outcome overlap exists.
